CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tracking_seed_shadow()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n integer;
begin
 insert into public.shipment_tracking_state(order_id,owner_id,account_id,provider,tracking_number,identity_key,label_created_at)
 select o.id,o.owner_id,a.id,a.provider,o.tracking_number,private.shipment_tracking_identity(o),o.label_created_at
 from public.fulfillment_orders o join public.integration_accounts a on a.id=o.shipping_integration_account_id and a.owner_id=o.owner_id
 join public.workspaces w on w.id=o.owner_id and w.status in('active','trialing')
 where a.enabled and a.status<>'disabled' and a.provider in('mrw','sendcloud','envia')
 and (o.shipping_provider=a.provider or (o.shipping_provider is null and a.provider='sendcloud' and o.sendcloud_parcel_id is not null))
 and o.pii_purged_at is null and nullif(o.tracking_number,'') is not null and o.label_cancelled_at is null
 and not private.shipment_tracking_terminal(a.provider,o.tracking_status_code)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.shipment_tracking_state existing where existing.order_id=o.id and existing.identity_key=private.shipment_tracking_identity(o)) order by o.label_created_at desc nulls last limit 1000
 on conflict(order_id) do update set owner_id=excluded.owner_id,account_id=excluded.account_id,provider=excluded.provider,tracking_number=excluded.tracking_number,identity_key=excluded.identity_key,label_created_at=excluded.label_created_at,
 normalized_state=null,raw_event_time=null,raw_code=null,raw_message=null,event_at=null,observed_at=null,movement_at=null,last_checked_at=null,next_poll_at=now(),failures=0,last_error=null,lease_id=null,lease_until=null
 where shipment_tracking_state.identity_key<>excluded.identity_key;
 get diagnostics n=row_count;return n;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tracking_reprocess_candidates()
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, owner_id uuid, account_id uuid, provider text, tracking_number text, normalized_state text, raw_code text, raw_message text, event_at timestamp with time zone, raw_event_time text, observed_at timestamp with time zone, movement_at timestamp with time zone, failures integer, next_poll_at timestamp with time zone, paused_until timestamp with time zone, version text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select s.order_id,s.owner_id,s.account_id,s.provider,s.tracking_number,
 s.normalized_state,s.raw_code,s.raw_message,s.event_at,s.raw_event_time,
 s.observed_at,s.movement_at,s.failures,s.next_poll_at,h.paused_until,md5(to_jsonb(s)::text)
 from public.shipment_tracking_state s
 join public.fulfillment_orders o on o.id=s.order_id and o.owner_id=s.owner_id
 join public.integration_accounts a on a.id=s.account_id and a.owner_id=s.owner_id and a.provider=s.provider
 join public.workspaces w on w.id=s.owner_id and w.status in('active','trialing')
 left join public.shipment_tracking_account_health h on h.account_id=s.account_id and h.owner_id=s.owner_id and h.provider=s.provider
 where a.enabled and a.status<>'disabled'
 and o.shipping_integration_account_id=s.account_id
 and (o.shipping_provider=s.provider or (o.shipping_provider is null and s.provider='sendcloud' and o.sendcloud_parcel_id is not null))
 and o.pii_purged_at is null and o.label_cancelled_at is null
 and nullif(trim(o.tracking_number),'') is not null
 and private.shipment_tracking_identity(o)=s.identity_key
 and coalesce(s.normalized_state,'') not in('delivered','returned','cancelled')
 and not private.shipment_tracking_terminal(s.provider,o.tracking_status_code)
 order by s.provider,s.order_id limit 1001;
$function$
